authentication: Normal Cognito Authorization Code + PKCE; each run revoked its own session (HTTP 204)

compatibilityRelease.note: Refusal-only: both PATCH bodies used current values and were refused before any write; legacy settings and event catalogue re-read unchanged (catalogue compared without its evaluatedAt instant). A first run failed only on that evaluatedAt comparison in the harness and is excluded.

readerRelease.note: Read-only. Includes the lockfile-only sharp 0.35.5 / shell-quote 1.12.0 audit repair. The first push of the reader source (92ad10c) failed only the dependency audit on newly published advisories and was never deployed.

ordering: The reader release was pushed only after the compatibility image was the single running task, so no instance wrote the four keys to the legacy store after the copy.
limitations: Ten other legacy keys, the client runtimeSettings cache, session readers and dropping AppSetting remain. Platform-scope editing of station-capable thresholds has no endpoint. P10.8 and G3 remain open.
